items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: So, I played a couple of... I went with Fisher, and I had his band up all around.

ctx.x: . The time they play in all that jazz stuff, there's too much breaks in it. Let me see. You know what I mean, Johnny? Yeah. It's not the right time at all at all. Yeah. I'm going to move your chair up. Yeah, that's... That sounded like... Beautiful, beautiful. That sounded like the old-time bands, didn't it? Don't miss it. Don't miss it. It was a lot of fun to play in those days. How come the drum beat came back to you so quickly? It's just... It was just natural that the drum beat came back to you, huh? No,…
What do you want to get out? What do you want to get?
